metrics.methodContext: Number of dams in the USACE National Inventory of Dams within one mile of the site. DEEP counts them. Note in the field any barrier the inventory does not show.

limitations: A mapped dam count is a proximity screen and cannot confirm passability or the severity of a barrier.
NID carries about 91,000 regulated dams while the National Aquatic Barrier Inventory maps over 500,000 barriers of all sizes, so zero mapped dams is frequently a false negative for passage.
Query failure is unscored, not Good.

metrics.basisStatement: Scored against a published criterion rather than against stations from this ecoregion. The criterion carries its own definition of reference, which need not match this assessment's.
metrics.basisLimit: A published criterion is not an estimate of this ecoregion's reference condition and may disagree with a reference curve where one exists.

referenceMethod.statement: Reference condition is set by a fixed landscape-pressure screen, never by a score. 2 curves are fitted to this ecoregion's own streams under the documented regional screen, which relaxes agriculture only. 15 borrow comparable least-disturbed stations from a wider region, stating the region and the transfer risk. 2 carry the national reference label: reference curve fitted to comparable least-disturbed stations drawn from the national pool, because this ecoregion and its parents hold too few of their own. 5 carry the published benchmark label: scored against a published criterion rather than against stations from this ecoregion. The criterion carries its own definition of reference, which need not match this assessment's. 11 rest on a flagged transfer: a comparable least-disturbed pool the recovery test did not confirm for this ecoregion, used because no validated source supports the metric here, with transfer risk unvalidated and confidence capped. A metric that no basis supports is not scored, and the function it would have scored is reported as unassessed.

insufficientReferenceSupport.statement: Insufficient reference support. No station pool, from this ecoregion's own least-disturbed streams or from a wider region under the regional screen, holds enough comparable stations with a value for this metric and passes acceptance. The local reference: 4 usable stations, below the floor of 10. This ecoregion under the regional screen: 9 usable stations, below the floor of 10. The Level II pool (5.2): The curve on this pool would rank pressured stations above reference stations (discrimination check inverted, area under the curve 0.24 over 17 reference and 45 pressured stations), so it is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). The Level I pool (5): The curve on this pool would rank pressured stations above reference stations (discrimination check inverted, area under the curve 0.37 over 17 reference and 112 pressured stations), so it is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). The NARS-9 pool (UMW): The curve on this pool would rank pressured stations above reference stations (discrimination check inverted, area under the curve 0.32 over 17 reference and 190 pressured stations), so it is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). No other basis supports it either. National reference: 13 matched national donors, but the curve on this pool would rank pressured stations above reference stations (discrimination check inverted, area under the curve 0.31 over 51 reference and 1786 pressured stations), so it is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). 6 national donors inside the comparability envelope, below the floor of 10. Modeled reference: The model registry holds no approved specification for this metric. Published benchmark: Every published biological criterion in the STAF assessment library is scored on a state-specific field index (Michigan Procedure 51, the Carolina IBI scores, the Wisconsin and Minnesota IBIs), none of which can be computed from NRSA data, so none measures the same quantity as this metric. EPA's own NRSA benchmarks are set on its multimetric indices, which this assessment carries as metrics of their own; an index benchmark is never applied to one of the metrics the index is built from. No curve was built and the metric is not scored.
